plugins.name: API Key Manager — مفتاح
plugins.description: Arabic/English API key manager with host light/dark theme. Imports all proxy models and exact-match reference prices in one action; unmatched models safely remain zero. Per-key pricing and actual fallback accounting. No Docker socket or custom image. Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Accounting is estimated; back up state before updates. Read INSTALL.md.
plugins.author: Abdulaziz

plugins.name: Gemini Desktop Preview
plugins.description: Gemini Desktop OAuth provider with account-discovered native model names and real mode selection, plus text Chat Completions and SSE. Native account examples: 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, 4 Argon. Separate from Antigravity and Gemini CLI. Refresh credentials after upgrading to discover modes. Preview: no tools, images or exact token usage.
plugins.author: Abdulaziz

plugins.name: Model Playground — شات التجربة
plugins.description: Arabic text chat and model picker for this proxy. Manual client API key, memory-only conversations, SSE streaming. Independently hardened fork of hex-ci/cpa-plugin-model-playground; no automatic management-key or API-key-list reading.
plugins.author: hex-ci / Abdulaziz local variant
